name: promolens
description: PromoLens - a Chrome extension that estimates how likely Reddit posts are to be promotional, with visible evidence and uncertainty.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/extension && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/extension/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
